title: teucrium aureum subsp. latifolium
intro: Teucrium aureum subsp. latifolium, commonly known as golden germander, is a plant species within the family Lamiaceae, characterized by its golden-yellow foliage and medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of T. aureum subsp. latifolium include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and provide a basis for its use in traditional medicine.
